steps.heading: Word twins and word opposites
steps.html:
Two special words help us play with meaning:

🔁 A synonym is a word that means the SAME (or nearly the same).
happy → glad, cheerful, joyful
↔️ An antonym is a word that means the OPPOSITE.
happy ↔ sad, miserable, gloomy

Tip: Synonyms are the same team. Antonyms are against each other!

steps.stem: Which word is a SYNONYM of 'brave'?
steps.explain: 'Fearless' means the same as 'brave' — full of courage.

steps.stem: Which word is an ANTONYM of 'begin'?

steps.heading: A clever trick: read the whole sentence
steps.html:
Some words change meaning depending on the sentence. Always read the whole sentence first.

The word 'light' can mean:
• not heavy → The bag was light.
• not dark → The room was light.
💡 Swap your answer back into the sentence. If it still makes sense, you've probably got it right!

steps.stem: Choose the SYNONYM of 'difficult' that fits: 'The puzzle was very ___.'
steps.explain: 'Tricky' means the same as 'difficult' and fits the sentence perfectly.

steps.heading: Watch out for 'nearly opposites' 🕵️
steps.html:
In tests, the wrong answers are often close but not quite. For an antonym of 'generous', you might see:

kind · caring · mean · helpful

Three of those are synonyms of generous — only 'mean' is the true opposite. Read every choice before you decide!

steps.stem: Which word is an ANTONYM of 'ancient'?
steps.explain: 'Modern' means new or recent — the opposite of 'ancient'. The others all mean old!

steps.stem: Which word is the ODD ONE OUT?
steps.explain: Whisper, mutter and murmur all mean speaking quietly — 'shout' is the odd one out.

steps.heading: You're a word detective now! 🔍
steps.html:
✅ Synonym = same meaning (same team 🔁)
✅ Antonym = opposite meaning (against ↔️)
✅ Always read the whole sentence and every choice.

Brilliant work! The more words you meet — in books, comics and chats — the stronger your word power grows. 🌟
